summary.intent: Address PR review feedback for Phase 30 and Phase 31 of the cipher-box project, fixing bugs and code quality issues identified by reviewers.
summary.outcome: All 6 Phase 31 review threads resolved and committed (isDescendantOf self-identity, isForbiddenError, non-null assertions, useCallback deps). Phase 30 faro.ts regex lastIndex reset fix also committed.

repo: Phase 31 work lives in a Claude worktree at .claude/worktrees/agent-a7d4653c
SDK package split: sdk-core holds folder/tree logic, sdk holds error handling and integration tests
ipnsControllerUnenrollBatch mock missing in client.test.ts deleteItem test — pre-existing issue introduced in Phase 29
@grafana/faro-web-tracing was missing from package.json and captureConsoleDisabledLevels is not a valid Faro option

code.finding: isDescendantOf had incorrect self-identity behavior — needed to return true when a node is compared to itself
isForbiddenError was missing the response.status check path that isConflictError already had — pattern should be mirrored between the two
hideSharedItem useCallback was missing p.setSharedItems and p.setError in its dependency array
Multiple non-null assertions (!) used in tests instead of explicit assertions — needed to be replaced with proper expect/assert calls
Regex lastIndex reset must occur BEFORE calling .test(), not after — stale lastIndex from a prior call can cause .test() to incorrectly return false

workflow: Pre-existing test failures should be identified and documented before committing to avoid confusion about whether changes introduced regressions
Integration tests that require a live API will always fail in CI without a running server — these are expected failures, not regressions
resolve-pr-reviews workflow covers: read review threads, read referenced code, apply fixes, run tests, commit, reply to threads, resolve threads

friction: client.test.ts deleteItem failure is a pre-existing issue from Phase 29 (missing ipnsControllerUnenrollBatch mock) that creates noise when running the test suite
@grafana/faro-web-tracing was omitted from a prior commit, requiring a follow-up fix push
open_items: client.test.ts deleteItem test needs ipnsControllerUnenrollBatch mock added — pre-existing debt from Phase 29
Integration tests require a running API to pass — no CI strategy mentioned for these
